checks.detail: Import and static starter discovery do not require the new WASM marker. Only state-table generation invokes the optional Rust operation; capability loss clears the reviewed proposal and invalidates pending handoff.

Only the fixed generator issues custom source under the existing private WeakSet brand. Exact creation request fields and current context checks remain; ordinary TXT creation and Save retain persistence authority.

Row object identities retain initial/from/to references during rename. Removed referenced rows remain missing, and a new row with the same key does not silently inherit them. Detached old row handlers fail ownership checks.

Every table edit regenerates or clears the proposal. Signature includes hidden table settings. Final handoff checks generation, source context, current form, proposal identity and core availability; silent edits require another visible preview.

Child refresh does not invoke onChange, so parent review/render and child refresh do not recurse. Reopen/reset/dispose revoke row ownership. Language refresh preserves input nodes and their selection.

All required ports and subscriptions precede initial playback. Event names bind to one callback each, unknown transitions return true, explicit self edges restart. Completion compares the captured selection. Select/play admission is not an execution receipt and failures do not claim rollback; lifecycle cleanup releases both subscription kinds.
Existing createScriptDraft independently rechecks ordinary proposal brand, clean editable context, source token and isCurrent immediately before synchronous in-memory draft creation.

boundaries: One controller per scene is an authoring convention; this slice adds no runtime arbitration or per-instance playhead.
Generated TXT is editable author source; this form does not reverse-parse arbitrary saved scripts.
Full application validation and old static starter byte comparisons are owned by the parent task.
